trees.name: The Gunline
trees.blurb: Firearms discipline: accuracy, fire rate, crits, reloads.

skills.name: Overcharge
skills.desc: Overload your weapon's feed: for 8 s (+0.25 s per Intelligence) your weapons hit harder and fire faster.

skills.name: Steady Hands
skills.desc: 25% less spread, +10% firearm damage.

skills.name: Marked Target
skills.desc: Tag the enemy under the cursor for 8 s: it takes +35% damage from you and shows on the minimap.

skills.name: Quick Hands
skills.desc: Reloads 30% faster, +20% magazine size.

skills.name: Deadeye
skills.desc: Your next 6 shots are guaranteed critical hits and pierce one enemy.

skills.name: Hollow Points
skills.desc: Critical hits make organic enemies bleed.

skills.name: Gunline Unbroken
skills.desc: Every firearm kill cuts all ability cooldowns by 1 s and refunds 5 rounds to the magazine.

trees.name: The Vanguard
trees.blurb: Close quarters and brute force: melee, armour, charging into the swarm.

skills.name: Disruptor Pulse
skills.desc: An energy blast around you: damages, stuns and interrupts nearby enemies, drops Security Heavies' shields and wipes out enemy projectiles.

skills.name: Iron Hide
skills.desc: +15% armour, +10% max health.

skills.name: Shoulder Charge
skills.desc: Dash forward, knocking back and stunning enemies in the way (1 s).

skills.name: Bloodletter
skills.desc: Melee hits heal you for 5% of the damage dealt.

skills.name: Battle Litany
skills.desc: 10 s: +50% melee damage, immune to stun and knockback, but take 15% more damage.

skills.name: Unbreakable
skills.desc: Below 30% health, take 25% less damage.

skills.name: Juggernaut
skills.desc: Melee kills grant 2 s of 90% damage reduction (at most once every 8 s).

trees.name: The Siegebreaker
trees.blurb: Demolitions and ordnance: the area-of-effect answer to swarms.

skills.name: Concussion Grenade
skills.desc: Throw an arcing grenade: area damage, knockback and a 0.8 s daze where it lands.

skills.name: Blast Discipline
skills.desc: Your explosions are 15% bigger and hit 15% harder.

skills.name: Semtex Charge
skills.desc: Throw a sticky charge that clings to the enemy it hits (or the floor) and blows after 1.5 s with a big blast.

skills.name: Shrapnel
skills.desc: Explosions send out fragments that also hit enemies just outside the blast.

skills.name: Incendiary Charge
skills.desc: A canister that leaves a burning zone for 5 s. The Brood hate fire (+25% against them).

skills.name: Chain Reaction
skills.desc: Enemies killed by your explosions explode themselves (small blast).

skills.name: Danger Close
skills.desc: Call in an OVERWATCH orbital strike: a 2 s targeting marker, then a barrage over a wide area.
